name: Lower Bthanual
summary: Lower Bthanual is a Dwemer ruin in central Deshaan, containing Dwemer constructs. It is located just north of the monastery at Muth Gnaar. Two books can be found here: the lorebook Dwemer Dreams can be found in the boss chamber, and a copy of War of Two Houses can be found on a table outside. Centipedes and rats are found in numbers within. The Construct's Pelvis is found on an anvil in the southwest corner of the north room.
notes: Swarming Dwarven Spiders in Lower Bthanual were called "Dwemer Spider Swarm‎" when ESO released, but they were quickly renamed properly.
